name: Better Than Smoking
summary:
Better Than Smoking is a game designed to simulate smoking.

It supports both mixed reality and virtual reality, so you can enjoy it in whichever mode you prefer.

We would like to add features and improve Better Than Smoking through updates, so please send us your feedback!
